proposal.title: Zorthrazor: a test runner for protocol specifications
proposal.summary: Zorthrazor builds a test runner for protocol specifications for authors of protocol libraries.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Protocol specifications change faster than their implementations are tested. Authors of protocol libraries are depending from open standards testing every day, yet tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We are going to build a test runner for protocol specifications called Zorthrazor. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Every component gets tests and a fuzz target before merging of it.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Open standards testing belongs into Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We are maintaining http://forge.test/zorthrazor/zorthrazor, which 269 public projects depend on. Our team is working on open standards testing for 3 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under MIT licence in http://forge.test/zorthrazor/zorthrazor. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 8 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 4. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 6. Documentation and release ends in month 8.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 83400.00 EUR for 142 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 650.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Problem
Protocol specifications change faster than their implementations are tested. Authors of protocol libraries are depending from open standards testing every day, yet tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

Approach
We are going to build a test runner for protocol specifications called Zorthrazor. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Every component gets tests and a fuzz target before merging of it.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Open standards testing belongs into Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We are maintaining http://forge.test/zorthrazor/zorthrazor, which 269 public projects depend on. Our team is working on open standards testing for 3 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under MIT licence in http://forge.test/zorthrazor/zorthrazor. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 8 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 4. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 6. Documentation and release ends in month 8.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 83400.00 EUR for 142 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 650.00 EUR.
